title: Run real Vision Observation over accepted uploaded photo refs

gates.name: real vision tests
gates.command: pytest backend/tests/model_adapters backend/tests/photo_artifacts backend/tests/agent_harness backend/tests/integration backend/tests/security

gates.name: harness evals
gates.command: pytest backend/tests/model_adapters backend/tests/agent_harness backend/tests/photo_artifacts backend/tests/integration -k 'vision or photo or eval'

verify: Vision Observation receives authorized accepted photo refs with catalog id, sha256, metadata, and backend-controlled file access.
Vision model processes actual uploaded photo binary or a real derivative from that photo.
Vision Observation outputs photo quality and visual observations only, with no diagnosis, physical-action advice, or Plant state mutation.
evidence_required: VERDICT: PASS, SEMANTIC_VERDICT: semantic-pass, HUMAN_CHECKPOINT: done, ROLLBACK_RECOVERY_NOTE: present
constraints: Vision adapter access is backend-controlled and scoped by ActorContext and PlantAccessGrant.
Missing file, unauthorized photo, unsupported format, provider failure, or unclear image returns structured failure.
Photo files/manifests are artifacts, not mutable Plant state authority.
invariants: Vision Observation cannot diagnose or recommend physical actions.
Raw vision output is not Plant fact until adapted through harness and owning state rules.
Secrets/auth material cannot enter manifests, traces, context, MessageEnvelope, Bus, UI Feed, or exports.
